WITH track_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    m.MediaTypeId,
    m.Name AS MediaTypeName,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 
      THEN CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS FLOAT)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ratio
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
),
media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    MediaTypeName,
    AVG(ratio) AS rate,
    COUNT(ratio) AS track_count
  FROM track_ratios
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId, MediaTypeName
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT 
  mtr.MediaTypeName AS name,
  mtr.rate,
  mtr.track_count,
  mtr.rate - om.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean
FROM media_type_rates mtr
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE mtr.rate > om.mean_rate
